Class SentenceGeneratorTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.SentenceGeneratorTest
public class SentenceGeneratorTest extends Object
Comprehensive test class for SentenceGenerator that verifies all aspects of sentence generation functionality including template processing, word substitution, default dictionary usage, and error handling.

The tests are organized into logical groups:

  • Positive test cases for normal operation
  • File operation tests for persistence functionality
  • Negative test cases for error handling

    • testGenerateSentences_WithCustomWords

      @Test public void testGenerateSentences_WithCustomWords() throws IOException
      Tests sentence generation with custom word lists. Verifies that:
      • The correct number of sentences is generated
      • All placeholders are properly replaced
      • Generated sentences match the expected pattern
      Throws:
      IOException - if dictionary operations fail

      Throws:
